compliance_decision:
1. No, reporting obligations cannot be waived due to client confidentiality as per the regulatory context provided.
2. PCC-36-Guidance-on-voluntary-disclosure-programme.txt (Chunk 7922)
3. The regulation states that a reporting obligation arises when income and/or foreign assets relevant to an application for voluntary disclosure relief come from unknown sources or unlawful activities as defined in the Prevention of Organised Crime Act, 1998 (Scenario 4.2). In cases where clients are absolving themselves legitimately from criminal liability due to past non-compliance with tax and/or exchange control obligations through voluntary disclosure relief, reporting is assumed necessary as it helps in identifying the source of income or assets for compliance purposes (Scenario 4.1).
4. Yes
